events.text: 「同事？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Colleagues?"

events.source: 「进了医院工作，就不能再摆大小姐的架子。」
events.text: 「进了医院工作，就不能再摆大小姐的架子。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Once you work at the hospital, you can't put on the airs of a rich young lady."

events.source: 「咦？院长，你怎么突然这么说？」
events.text: 「咦？院长，你怎么突然这么说？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Huh? Director, why are you suddenly saying that?"

events.source: 「我很好相处的！上次住院的时候，我跟护士姐姐们都聊得很开心呀！」
events.text: 「我很好相处的！上次住院的时候，我跟护士姐姐们都聊得很开心呀！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I'm easy to get along with! I had a great time chatting with all the nurses during my stay!"

events.source: 「我知道。你很喜欢这里的医护人员，她们也一直认真照顾你。」
events.text: 「我知道。你很喜欢这里的医护人员，她们也一直认真照顾你。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "I know. You like the staff here, and they took good care of you."

events.source: 「对呀！那为什么还要特别提醒我？」
events.text: 「对呀！那为什么还要特别提醒我？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Exactly! So why the special warning?"

events.source: 「因为你之前是患者。现在，你准备成为和她们一起工作的人。」
events.text: 「因为你之前是患者。现在，你准备成为和她们一起工作的人。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Because before, you were a patient. Now you're preparing to work alongside them."

events.source: 「……这有什么区别？」
events.text: 「……这有什么区别？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...What's the difference?"

events.source: 「你还记得当初听到手术报价时，自己说了什么吗？」
events.text: 「你还记得当初听到手术报价时，自己说了什么吗？」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Do you remember what you said when you first heard the surgery quote?"

events.source: 「……我说钱不是问题？」
events.text: 「……我说钱不是问题？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...That money wasn't a problem?"

events.source: 「你说，那点费用大概就是你一个月的零花钱。」
events.text: 「你说，那点费用大概就是你一个月的零花钱。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "You said the cost was about one month's spending money for you."

events.source: 「可是那是真的呀。」
events.text: 「可是那是真的呀。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "But that was true."

events.source: 「我没有说你在撒谎。」
events.text: 「我没有说你在撒谎。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "I didn't say you were lying."

events.source: 「那有什么不妥吗？」
events.text: 「那有什么不妥吗？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Then what's wrong with it?"

events.source: 「医院里有家境优渥的医生，也有靠自己薪水生活、需要认真计划每一笔开销的护士。」
events.text: 「医院里有家境优渥的医生，也有靠自己薪水生活、需要认真计划每一笔开销的护士。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "The hospital has doctors from comfortable backgrounds, and nurses who live on their wages and carefully plan every expense."

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Yeah."

events.source: 「你觉得无所谓的一笔钱，可能是某位同事努力好几个月才能攒下来的。」
events.text: 「你觉得无所谓的一笔钱，可能是某位同事努力好几个月才能攒下来的。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "An amount that means little to you might take a colleague months of hard work to save."

events.source: 「如果你随口说『才这么点钱』，听到的人未必会觉得你在开玩笑。」
events.text: 「如果你随口说『才这么点钱』，听到的人未必会觉得你在开玩笑。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "If you casually say, 'It's only that much,' the person hearing it might not think you're joking."

events.source: 「可是我又没有看不起她们！」
events.text: 「可是我又没有看不起她们！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "But I'm not looking down on them!"

events.source: 「我相信你没有。」
events.text: 「我相信你没有。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "I believe you."

events.source: 「我是真的觉得护士们很厉害耶！特别是我开刀那天，她们做什么都那么熟练。」
events.text: 「我是真的觉得护士们很厉害耶！特别是我开刀那天，她们做什么都那么熟练。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I really do think the nurses are amazing! Especially on the day of my operation. Everything they did was so practiced."

events.source: 「正因为你欣赏她们，我才希望你能想想，大家听见你的话会是什么感受。」
events.text: 「正因为你欣赏她们，我才希望你能想想，大家听见你的话会是什么感受。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "It's precisely because you admire them that I'd like you to think about how your words might make them feel."

events.source: 【瑞穗低头看着自己手里的账单。】
events.text: 【瑞穗低头看着自己手里的账单。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho looks down at the bill in her hands.]

events.source: 「……也就是说，我觉得某件东西便宜，不能随便在别人面前说出来？」
events.text: 「……也就是说，我觉得某件东西便宜，不能随便在别人面前说出来？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...So if I think something's cheap, I shouldn't just say it in front of people?"

events.source: 「至少在工作场合，不需要拿自己的消费尺度去衡量别人的生活。」
events.text: 「至少在工作场合，不需要拿自己的消费尺度去衡量别人的生活。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "At least at work, there's no need to measure other people's lives by your own spending standards."

events.source: 「……可它在我看来就是便宜嘛。」
events.text: 「……可它在我看来就是便宜嘛。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...But it is cheap to me."

events.source: 「你可以这么想。不必把每个想法都拿来当大家聊天的共同标准。」
events.text: 「你可以这么想。不必把每个想法都拿来当大家聊天的共同标准。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "You can think that. Not every thought needs to become the shared standard for everyone's conversation."

events.source: 「很多人，没有我们那么幸运。」
events.text: 「很多人，没有我们那么幸运。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Many people haven't been as fortunate as we have."

events.source: 【明日香的声音仍然平和。瑞穗看着她，认真听着。】
events.text: 【明日香的声音仍然平和。瑞穗看着她，认真听着。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Asuka's voice remains calm. Mizuho looks at her and listens carefully.]

events.source: 「……院长。你也是在说你自己吗？」
events.text: 「……院长。你也是在说你自己吗？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Director. Are you talking about yourself too?"

events.source: 「是。我也需要记得这一点。」
events.text: 「是。我也需要记得这一点。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Yes. I need to remember that too."

events.source: 「……原来如此。」
events.text: 「……原来如此。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...I see."

events.source: 「那如果同事问我，怎么会来医院上班呢？」
events.text: 「那如果同事问我，怎么会来医院上班呢？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Then what if a colleague asks why I came to work at the hospital?"

events.source: 「照实回答就好。」
events.text: 「照实回答就好。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Just tell the truth."

events.source: 「照实说？我不是要假装自己家境普通吗？」
events.text: 「照实说？我不是要假装自己家境普通吗？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "The truth? Aren't I supposed to pretend my family is ordinary?"

events.source: 「我什么时候叫你假装了？」
events.text: 「我什么时候叫你假装了？」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "When did I ask you to pretend?"

events.source: 「……好像没有。」
events.text: 「……好像没有。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...I guess you didn't."

events.source: 「你有一笔医疗费尚未结清，正在通过医院的工作合同处理。这是事实。」
events.text: 「你有一笔医疗费尚未结清，正在通过医院的工作合同处理。这是事实。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "You have an outstanding medical bill, and you're addressing it through an employment contract with the hospital. That's the truth."

events.source: 「……咦？就这样？」
events.text: 「……咦？就这样？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Huh? That's all?"

events.source: 「就这样。别人问到你的家庭，你也不必编造故事。只是没有必要主动向所有同事报出你的零花钱和家里的资产。」
events.text: 「就这样。别人问到你的家庭，你也不必编造故事。只是没有必要主动向所有同事报出你的零花钱和家里的资产。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "That's all. You don't need to invent stories if someone asks about your family either. There's simply no need to volunteer your allowance and family assets to every colleague."

events.source: 「……我明白一点了。」
events.text: 「……我明白一点了。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...I think I'm starting to understand."

events.source: 「说说看？」
events.text: 「说说看？」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Tell me."

events.source: 「就是……别因为我觉得一件事很轻松，就以为别人也该觉得轻松？」
events.text: 「就是……别因为我觉得一件事很轻松，就以为别人也该觉得轻松？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "It's... just because something seems easy to me, I shouldn't assume it should be easy for everyone else?"

events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Yes."

events.source: 「以前我在这里是病人，护士姐姐们会照顾我。以后我总不能还摆出『我付了钱，你们快来帮我』的样子。」
events.text: 「以前我在这里是病人，护士姐姐们会照顾我。以后我总不能还摆出『我付了钱，你们快来帮我』的样子。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I used to be a patient here, and the nurses looked after me. I can't keep acting like, 'I paid, so hurry up and help me.'"

events.source: 「正是这样。」
events.text: 「正是这样。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Exactly."

events.source: 「而且我现在还是最不会做事的那个……」
events.text: 「而且我现在还是最不会做事的那个……」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "And right now, I'll be the one who knows the least about doing the job..."

events.source: 【瑞穗挠了挠头，有点不好意思。】
events.text: 【瑞穗挠了挠头，有点不好意思。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho scratches her head, a little embarrassed.]

events.source: 「……好啦，我会注意。」
events.text: 「……好啦，我会注意。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...All right. I'll be careful."

events.source: 「不过如果我不小心说漏嘴，你可别一下子把我开除哦！」
events.text: 「不过如果我不小心说漏嘴，你可别一下子把我开除哦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "But if I accidentally let something slip, don't fire me right away!"

events.source: 「先学着听取提醒，再改正就好。」
events.text: 「先学着听取提醒，再改正就好。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Learn to listen when someone points it out, and correct yourself."

events.source: 「……嘿嘿。那我大概能做到。」
events.text: 「……嘿嘿。那我大概能做到。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Hehe. I think I can manage that."

events.source: 【明日香把合同与工作说明一起推到瑞穗面前。】
events.text: 【明日香把合同与工作说明一起推到瑞穗面前。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Asuka pushes the contract and job description toward Mizuho.]

events.source: 「最后确认一次。三个月的临时护理辅助工作，你自愿接受吗？」
events.text: 「最后确认一次。三个月的临时护理辅助工作，你自愿接受吗？」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "One final confirmation. Do you voluntarily accept three months of temporary nursing support work?"

events.source: 「接受！」
events.text: 「接受！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I do!"

events.source: 「需要正常工作，遵守病区与手术室的安排，听从有资格的人员指导。」
events.text: 「需要正常工作，遵守病区与手术室的安排，听从有资格的人员指导。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "You'll need to work regularly, follow ward and operating-room arrangements, and take guidance from qualified personnel."

events.source: 「知道！」
events.text: 「知道！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Understood!"

events.source: 「既然如此，认真看完以后再签。」
events.text: 「既然如此，认真看完以后再签。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Then read it carefully before you sign."

events.source: 【瑞穗拿起合同仔细看了起来。】
events.text: 【瑞穗拿起合同仔细看了起来。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho picks up the contract and reads it carefully.]

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Director."

events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Hm?"

events.source: 「我之前一直以为，只要自己付得起钱，很多事情就能照我喜欢的方式做。」
events.text: 「我之前一直以为，只要自己付得起钱，很多事情就能照我喜欢的方式做。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I used to think that as long as I could afford it, lots of things could be done the way I liked."

events.source: 「这次发现不完全是这样？」
events.text: 「这次发现不完全是这样？」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "And this time you've found that isn't entirely true?"

events.source: 「算是吧。不过这台手术是我自己选的，账单也应该由我自己负责。」
events.text: 「算是吧。不过这台手术是我自己选的，账单也应该由我自己负责。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Something like that. But I chose this operation, so I should take responsibility for the bill too."

events.source: 「这是你的选择。」
events.text: 「这是你的选择。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "That's your choice."

events.source: 「……而且来星见工作，好像也不是什么坏事。」
events.text: 「……而且来星见工作，好像也不是什么坏事。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...And working at Hoshimi doesn't seem like such a bad thing."

events.source: 「或许会比你想的忙。」
events.text: 「或许会比你想的忙。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "It may be busier than you imagine."

events.source: 「那更好！我现在反正有时间！」
events.text: 「那更好！我现在反正有时间！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Even better! I've got time right now anyway!"

events.source: 【瑞穗看完合同，签上自己的名字。】
events.text: 【瑞穗看完合同，签上自己的名字。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho finishes reading the contract and signs her name.]

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Done!"

events.source: 「欢迎你来星见工作，支手小姐。」
events.text: 「欢迎你来星见工作，支手小姐。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Welcome to Hoshimi, Ms. Shite."

events.source: 「谢谢院长！」
events.text: 「谢谢院长！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Thank you, Director!"

events.source: 「那我这次终于不用躺在手术台上，也能看医生们忙了吧？」
events.text: 「那我这次终于不用躺在手术台上，也能看医生们忙了吧？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "So this time I can finally watch the doctors work without lying on the operating table?"

events.source: 「……先从你能做的事情开始。」
events.text: 「……先从你能做的事情开始。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "...Start with the things you can do."

events.source: 「哈哈哈！收到！」
events.text: 「哈哈哈！收到！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Hahaha! Got it!"

events.source: 【同一天稍后。瑞穗带着签好的工作资料，来到千早的住处。千早正在整理两人赴纽约前需要完成的手续。】
events.text: 【同一天稍后。瑞穗带着签好的工作资料，来到千早的住处。千早正在整理两人赴纽约前需要完成的手续。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Later that day, Mizuho brings her signed employment papers to Chihaya's home. Chihaya is organizing the paperwork they need to finish before going to New York.]

events.source: 「瑞穗？你今天不是说要去星见找城宮院长吗？」
events.text: 「瑞穗？你今天不是说要去星见找城宮院长吗？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Mizuho? Didn't you say you were going to Hoshimi to see Director Shiromiya today?"

events.source: 「我去啦！而且事情已经解决得差不多了！」
events.text: 「我去啦！而且事情已经解决得差不多了！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I did! And it's pretty much sorted out!"

events.source: 「真的？你爸愿意把账户解冻了？」
events.text: 「真的？你爸愿意把账户解冻了？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Really? Your dad agreed to unfreeze the account?"

events.source: 「……那倒没有。」
events.text: 「……那倒没有。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Not exactly."

events.source: 「咦？那怎么解决的？」
events.text: 「咦？那怎么解决的？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Huh? Then how did you sort it out?"

events.source: 【瑞穗把医院的临时聘用说明放到桌上。】
events.text: 【瑞穗把医院的临时聘用说明放到桌上。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho puts the hospital's temporary employment information on the table.]

events.source: 「锵锵——！你看这个！」
events.text: 「锵锵——！你看这个！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Ta-da! Look at this!"

events.source: 「……星见医院临时护理辅助人员？」
events.text: 「……星见医院临时护理辅助人员？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Temporary nursing support staff at Hoshimi Hospital?"

events.source: 「没错！城宮院长说，只要我认真工作三个月，剩下那半笔手术费就能按员工福利处理！」
events.text: 「没错！城宮院长说，只要我认真工作三个月，剩下那半笔手术费就能按员工福利处理！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "That's right! Director Shiromiya says if I work properly for three months, the remaining half of the surgery bill can be handled through employee benefits!"

events.source: 「怎么样？是不是很厉害！」
events.text: 「怎么样？是不是很厉害！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Well? Pretty amazing, right?"

events.source: 「……等一下。你的意思是，你要去医院上班？」
events.text: 「……等一下。你的意思是，你要去医院上班？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Wait. You mean you're going to work at the hospital?"

events.source: 「对呀。」
events.text: 「对呀。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Yep."

events.source: 「不是去复查？」
events.text: 「不是去复查？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Not go for a follow-up?"

events.source: 「不是。」
events.text: 「不是。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "No."

events.source: 「也不是去住院？」
events.text: 「也不是去住院？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "And not be admitted?"

events.source: 「当然不是啦！」
events.text: 「当然不是啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Of course not!"

events.source: 「……瑞穗，你以前不是说，绝对不想再进手术室了吗？」
events.text: 「……瑞穗，你以前不是说，绝对不想再进手术室了吗？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Mizuho, didn't you say you never wanted to go into an operating room again?"

events.source: 「那是说不想再躺在手术台上！这次是换我站在旁边忙！」
events.text: 「那是说不想再躺在手术台上！这次是换我站在旁边忙！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I meant I didn't want to lie on the operating table again! This time I'll be the one working beside it!"

events.source: 「这也太突然了吧！」
events.text: 「这也太突然了吧！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "This is so sudden!"

events.source: 「我觉得挺好呀。我本来就有时间，而且一直待在家里也很无聊。」
events.text: 「我觉得挺好呀。我本来就有时间，而且一直待在家里也很无聊。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I think it's great. I have the time anyway, and staying home all day is boring."

events.source: 【千早翻了翻工作说明，目光停在期限上。】
events.text: 【千早翻了翻工作说明，目光停在期限上。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Chihaya leafs through the job description, her gaze stopping at the contract period.]

events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Three months."

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Yep!"

events.source: 「你爸这次真的把你平常用的钱都停了？」
events.text: 「你爸这次真的把你平常用的钱都停了？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Did your dad really cut off all the money you normally use?"

events.source: 「零花钱账户用不了。家里其他东西都还在啦，又不是突然破产！」
events.text: 「零花钱账户用不了。家里其他东西都还在啦，又不是突然破产！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I can't use the spending account. Everything else at home is still there. We didn't suddenly go bankrupt!"

events.source: 「我当然知道。可是你那台手术真的很贵耶。」
events.text: 「我当然知道。可是你那台手术真的很贵耶。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "I know that. But your operation was really expensive."

events.source: 「我知道！前一半已经付了，剩下的等我做完工作就解决。」
events.text: 「我知道！前一半已经付了，剩下的等我做完工作就解决。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I know! I've paid the first half, and the rest will be sorted out when I finish the work."

events.source: 「……其实，你不用一个人烦恼呀。」
events.text: 「……其实，你不用一个人烦恼呀。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...You don't have to worry about this alone."

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Hm?"

events.source: 「要不我先借你？把剩下的付了不就好了？」
events.text: 「要不我先借你？把剩下的付了不就好了？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "What if I lend you the money for now? Then you could pay the rest."

events.source: 【瑞穗愣了一下，看着千早。】
events.text: 【瑞穗愣了一下，看着千早。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho pauses and looks at Chihaya.]

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Chihaya."

events.source: 「反正我现在拿得出来。你之后有钱了再还就好。」
events.text: 「反正我现在拿得出来。你之后有钱了再还就好。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "I can afford it right now. You can pay me back when you have access to your money again."

events.source: 「谢谢你。不过不用啦。」
events.text: 「谢谢你。不过不用啦。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Thank you. But there's no need."

events.source: 「咦？为什么？」
events.text: 「咦？为什么？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Huh? Why not?"

events.source: 「开刀是我自己决定的。我想把自己做的事好好处理完，不用你替我付这笔钱。」
events.text: 「开刀是我自己决定的。我想把自己做的事好好处理完，不用你替我付这笔钱。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "The operation was my decision. I want to take care of what I did myself. You don't need to pay this for me."

events.source: 【千早看着她，慢慢把资料放回桌上。】
events.text: 【千早看着她，慢慢把资料放回桌上。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Chihaya looks at her and slowly puts the papers back on the table.]

events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...I see."

events.source: 「而且，你不觉得去星见当几个月护士挺好玩的吗？」
events.text: 「而且，你不觉得去星见当几个月护士挺好玩的吗？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Besides, don't you think being a nurse at Hoshimi for a few months sounds fun?"

events.source: 「还能再见到坂口医生、御園医生，还有那些护士姐姐们耶！」
events.text: 「还能再见到坂口医生、御園医生，还有那些护士姐姐们耶！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "We'd get to see Dr. Sakaguchi, Dr. Misono, and all those nurses again!"

events.source: 「上次我在手术台上只顾着大叫，这次终于可以看看她们平时到底在忙什么了！」
events.text: 「上次我在手术台上只顾着大叫，这次终于可以看看她们平时到底在忙什么了！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Last time I was too busy screaming on the table. Now I can finally see what they actually do all day!"

events.source: 「你不会真的把护士工作当成换装游戏吧？」
events.text: 「你不会真的把护士工作当成换装游戏吧？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "You're not really treating nursing work like a dress-up game, are you?"

events.source: 「怎么会！院长跟我说了好多注意事项。要认真工作、不能乱碰东西，还得听前辈的话。」
events.text: 「怎么会！院长跟我说了好多注意事项。要认真工作、不能乱碰东西，还得听前辈的话。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Of course not! The director gave me lots of instructions. Work seriously, don't touch things without permission, and listen to the experienced staff."

events.source: 「……你竟然全部答应了？」
events.text: 「……你竟然全部答应了？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...And you actually agreed to all of it?"

events.source: 「我有那么不靠谱吗？！！」
events.text: 「我有那么不靠谱吗？！！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Am I that unreliable?!!"

events.source: 「……我只是有点意外。」
events.text: 「……我只是有点意外。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...I'm just a little surprised."

events.source: 【瑞穗噘了噘嘴，随即又开心地翻开制服领取说明。】
events.text: 【瑞穗噘了噘嘴，随即又开心地翻开制服领取说明。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho pouts, then happily opens the uniform collection instructions.]

events.source: 「你看！我们可以穿星见那套白色护士服哦！」
events.text: 「你看！我们可以穿星见那套白色护士服哦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Look! We can wear Hoshimi's white nurse uniform!"

events.source: 「……还真是耶。」
events.text: 「……还真是耶。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...We really can."

events.source: 「怎么样？我穿起来一定很合适！」
events.text: 「怎么样？我穿起来一定很合适！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Well? It'll definitely suit me!"

events.source: 「你先别光顾着想衣服啦。」
events.text: 「你先别光顾着想衣服啦。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Don't get caught up thinking only about the clothes."

events.source: 【千早看着那份三个月工作安排，沉默了一会儿。】
events.text: 【千早看着那份三个月工作安排，沉默了一会儿。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Chihaya looks at the three-month work arrangement and falls silent for a while.]

events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Mizuho."

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Hm?"

events.source: 「那我也去。」
events.text: 「那我也去。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Then I'll go too."

events.source: 「我也去星见应聘。」
events.text: 「我也去星见应聘。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "I'll apply to Hoshimi too."

events.source: 「等等，你又没有欠手术费，为什么要来？」
events.text: 「等等，你又没有欠手术费，为什么要来？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Wait, you don't owe any surgery fees. Why would you come?"

events.source: 「因为你在呀。」
events.text: 「因为你在呀。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Because you'll be there."

events.source: 「你当初为了陪我，连肚子都开了。现在轮到你有事，我也不能丢下你一个人呀。」
events.text: 「你当初为了陪我，连肚子都开了。现在轮到你有事，我也不能丢下你一个人呀。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "You even had your abdomen opened to stay with me. Now that something's happened to you, I can't leave you on your own."

events.source: 【瑞穗张着嘴看了她好一会儿。】
events.text: 【瑞穗张着嘴看了她好一会儿。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho stares at her, mouth open, for quite a while.]

events.source: 「……你这话说得，好像我那次开刀很伟大似的。」
events.text: 「……你这话说得，好像我那次开刀很伟大似的。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...You make my operation sound like some great heroic deed."

events.source: 「难道不是吗？虽然你选不麻醉那件事，我到现在都想不通！」
events.text: 「难道不是吗？虽然你选不麻醉那件事，我到现在都想不通！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Wasn't it? Though I still can't understand why you chose no anesthesia!"

events.source: 「……哈哈哈。那是我的经典失策啦。」
events.text: 「……哈哈哈。那是我的经典失策啦。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Hahaha. That was one of my classic bad decisions."

events.source: 「你自己说的哦。」
events.text: 「你自己说的哦。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "You said it yourself."

events.source: 「可是千早，你真的不用为了我去工作。我一个人也能应付的！」
events.text: 「可是千早，你真的不用为了我去工作。我一个人也能应付的！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "But Chihaya, you really don't need to work for my sake. I can handle it alone!"

events.source: 「我知道你可以。不过，两个人不是更有意思吗？」
events.text: 「我知道你可以。不过，两个人不是更有意思吗？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "I know you can. But wouldn't it be more fun with two of us?"

events.source: 「我们一起在医院住过院，一起出院。那就再一起去上班嘛。」
events.text: 「我们一起在医院住过院，一起出院。那就再一起去上班嘛。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "We stayed in the hospital together and left together. So let's go to work together too."

events.source: 【瑞穗忽然笑了起来。】
events.text: 【瑞穗忽然笑了起来。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho suddenly laughs.]

events.source: 「……哎呀！你早说你也想穿护士服嘛！」
events.text: 「……哎呀！你早说你也想穿护士服嘛！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Oh! You should've just said you wanted to wear a nurse uniform too!"

events.source: 「才不是因为这个！！」
events.text: 「才不是因为这个！！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "That's not why!!"

events.source: 「好好好。那我们去找院长问问！」
events.text: 「好好好。那我们去找院长问问！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Okay, okay. Then let's go ask the director!"

events.source: 「……现在就去？」
events.text: 「……现在就去？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Right now?"

events.source: 「趁热打铁！」
events.text: 「趁热打铁！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Strike while the iron's hot!"

events.source: 「你也太着急了吧！」
events.text: 「你也太着急了吧！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "You're in such a hurry!"

events.source: 【两人收好资料，一起回到星见医院询问岗位安排。】
events.text: 【两人收好资料，一起回到星见医院询问岗位安排。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [They gather the papers and return together to Hoshimi Hospital to ask about available work.]

events.source: 【院长办公室。明日香听完千早的来意，将另一份工作说明放到她面前。】
events.text: 【院长办公室。明日香听完千早的来意，将另一份工作说明放到她面前。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [In the director's office, Asuka listens to Chihaya's request and places another job description in front of her.]

events.source: 「仓本小姐，你也想报名三个月的临时护理辅助工作？」
events.text: 「仓本小姐，你也想报名三个月的临时护理辅助工作？」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Ms. Kuramoto, you'd also like to apply for three months of temporary nursing support work?"

events.source: 「是的。我想和瑞穗一起工作。」
events.text: 「是的。我想和瑞穗一起工作。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Yes. I'd like to work with Mizuho."

events.source: 「你没有同样的医疗费问题，不需要为她承担合同上的义务。」
events.text: 「你没有同样的医疗费问题，不需要为她承担合同上的义务。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "You don't have the same medical bill problem. You don't need to take on her contractual obligations."

events.source: 「我知道。我是自己想来的。」
events.text: 「我知道。我是自己想来的。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "I know. I want to come of my own accord."

events.source: 「我刚才也跟她说过啦！可她就是想跟我一起！」
events.text: 「我刚才也跟她说过啦！可她就是想跟我一起！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I told her that too! But she wants to be with me!"

events.source: 「呵呵。你们感情真好。」
events.text: 「呵呵。你们感情真好。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Hehe. You're very close."

events.source: 「……也没有那么夸张啦。」
events.text: 「……也没有那么夸张啦。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...It's not that dramatic."

events.source: 「不过既然应聘，工作要求和支手小姐相同。不能因为是朋友，就只挑喜欢的事情做。」
events.text: 「不过既然应聘，工作要求和支手小姐相同。不能因为是朋友，就只挑喜欢的事情做。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "But if you apply, the job requirements will be the same as Ms. Shite's. Being friends doesn't mean you can pick only the tasks you like."

events.source: 「明白。我会认真学的。」
events.text: 「明白。我会认真学的。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Understood. I'll learn properly."

events.source: 「我也会！」
events.text: 「我也会！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Me too!"

events.source: 「那么，二位的合同就安排从同一天开始。正式工作以前，会有人带你们完成登记和岗位说明。」
events.text: 「那么，二位的合同就安排从同一天开始。正式工作以前，会有人带你们完成登记和岗位说明。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Then we'll arrange for your contracts to begin on the same day. Before you start working, someone will guide you through registration and your role orientation."

events.source: 「谢谢院长！」
events.text: 「谢谢院长！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Thank you, Director!"

events.source: 「太好了！我们要一起当护士啦！」
events.text: 「太好了！我们要一起当护士啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Great! We're going to be nurses together!"

events.source: 「是临时护理辅助人员哦。」
events.text: 「是临时护理辅助人员哦。」
events.speaker: 明日香
events.en: "Temporary nursing support staff."

events.source: 「……啊哈哈，知道啦！」
events.text: 「……啊哈哈，知道啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Ahaha, I know!"

events.source: 【明日香看着两人的兴奋模样，微笑着将入职资料交给她们。】
events.text: 【明日香看着两人的兴奋模样，微笑着将入职资料交给她们。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Smiling at their excitement, Asuka hands them the onboarding papers.]

events.source: 【正式上班前，两人按安排完成入职登记和基础岗位说明。】
events.text: 【正式上班前，两人按安排完成入职登记和基础岗位说明。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Before their first day, they complete registration and basic role orientation as arranged.]

events.source: 【正式入职日 R 上午八点过后。星见医院员工更衣区。两人已经换上日式纯白护士裙制服和护士帽，正在整理衣领与袖口。她们的制服没有正式护士名牌。】
events.text: 【星见医院员工更衣区。两人已经换上日式纯白护士裙制服和护士帽，正在整理衣领与袖口。她们的制服没有正式护士名牌。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [The staff changing area at Hoshimi Hospital. Both have changed into pure white Japanese-style nurse dresses and caps and are straightening their collars and cuffs. Their uniforms have no official nurse name badges.]

events.source: 【瑞穗转了一圈，看了看镜子里的自己。】
events.text: 【瑞穗转了一圈，看了看镜子里的自己。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho turns around and looks at herself in the mirror.]

events.source: 「千早！快看！怎么样？」
events.text: 「千早！快看！怎么样？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Chihaya! Look! What do you think?"

events.source: 「很适合你呀！」
events.text: 「很适合你呀！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "It really suits you!"

events.source: 「对吧！我也觉得！」
events.text: 「对吧！我也觉得！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Right? I think so too!"

events.source: 「可是你从刚才开始已经问第三遍了耶。」
events.text: 「可是你从刚才开始已经问第三遍了耶。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "But that's the third time you've asked already."

events.source: 「因为真的很好看嘛！」
events.text: 「因为真的很好看嘛！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Because it really does look good!"

events.source: 【千早也低头看了看自己的护士服，轻轻整理裙摆。】
events.text: 【千早也低头看了看自己的护士服，轻轻整理裙摆。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Chihaya also looks down at her own uniform and gently straightens the skirt.]

events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...This feels so strange."

events.source: 「怎么啦？」
events.text: 「怎么啦？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "What's wrong?"

events.source: 「上个月我还穿着病服，在病床上等护士来给我换药。」
events.text: 「上个月我还穿着病服，在病床上等护士来给我换药。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Last month I was still wearing patient clothes, waiting in bed for a nurse to change my dressing."

events.source: 「后来又穿刷手服，坐在手术室里陪你。」
events.text: 「后来又穿刷手服，坐在手术室里陪你。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Then I wore scrubs and sat in the operating room to keep you company."

events.source: 「而且那次你看起来真的很像老手！」
events.text: 「而且那次你看起来真的很像老手！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "And you really looked like an old hand that time!"

events.source: 「……明明紧张得要命。」
events.text: 「……明明紧张得要命。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...I was terrified."

events.source: 「现在不一样了！以后我们是来帮忙的！」
events.text: 「现在不一样了！以后我们是来帮忙的！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Now it's different! We're here to help!"

events.source: 「嗯……不过我还是有点紧张耶。」
events.text: 「嗯……不过我还是有点紧张耶。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Yeah... But I'm still a little nervous."

events.source: 「怕什么？我们又不是来开刀的。」
events.text: 「怕什么？我们又不是来开刀的。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "What's there to fear? We're not here for surgery."

events.source: 「……你以前就是这么说的。」
events.text: 「……你以前就是这么说的。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...That's what you said before."

events.source: 【两人对看一眼，忍不住笑了。】
events.text: 【两人对看一眼，忍不住笑了。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [They look at each other and can't help laughing.]

events.source: 【更衣区外有人敲门。】
events.text: 【更衣区外有人敲门。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Someone knocks outside the changing area.]

events.source: 「两位换好了吗？我来带你们去工作区。」
events.text: 「两位换好了吗？我来带你们去工作区。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Are you both ready? I'm here to take you to the work area."

events.source: 「朝仓护士？！」
events.text: 「朝仓护士？！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Nurse Asakura?!"

events.source: 「哇！今天是你来带我们！」
events.text: 「哇！今天是你来带我们！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Wow! You're showing us around today!"

events.source: 【两人走出更衣区。朝仓穿着平常的护士制服，看了看两名新人的装束。】
events.text: 【两人走出更衣区。朝仓穿着平常的护士制服，看了看两名新人的装束。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [They leave the changing area. In her usual nurse uniform, Asakura looks over the two newcomers.]

events.source: 「很合适呢。支手小姐、仓本小姐，欢迎回来。」
events.text: 「很合适呢。支手小姐、仓本小姐，欢迎回来。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "They suit you very well. Welcome back, Ms. Shite, Ms. Kuramoto."

events.source: 「谢谢！不过你这么一叫，我总觉得自己还在住院。」
events.text: 「谢谢！不过你这么一叫，我总觉得自己还在住院。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Thank you! But when you call us that, I feel like I'm still a patient."

events.source: 「那以后你们可要习惯，听见自己的名字时，不一定是被叫去检查。」
events.text: 「那以后你们可要习惯，听见自己的名字时，不一定是被叫去检查。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Then you'll have to get used to hearing your names without it necessarily meaning you're being called for an examination."

events.source: 「哈哈！说得也是。」
events.text: 「哈哈！说得也是。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Haha! True."

events.source: 【朝仓将当天的辅助工作安排交给两人。】
events.text: 【朝仓将当天的辅助工作安排交给两人。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Asakura gives them the day's support-work assignments.]

events.source: 「先从普通的病区准备和物品交接开始。你们会跟着正式护士学习。」
events.text: 「先从普通的病区准备和物品交接开始。你们会跟着正式护士学习。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "We'll start with ordinary ward preparation and supply handovers. You'll learn alongside qualified nurses."

events.source: 「收到！有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？」
events.text: 「收到！有什么需要我们帮忙的吗？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Got it! Is there anything we can help with?"

events.source: 「当然有。先把这几盒备用物品按标记整理好，再送到指定的工作位置。」
events.text: 「当然有。先把这几盒备用物品按标记整理好，再送到指定的工作位置。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Of course. First organize these boxes of spare supplies by their markings, then take them to the designated work positions."

events.source: 「就这样？很简单嘛！」
events.text: 「就这样？很简单嘛！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "That's all? Sounds easy!"

events.source: 「瑞穗，先看标签。」
events.text: 「瑞穗，先看标签。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Mizuho, read the labels first."

events.source: 「我有看啦！」
events.text: 「我有看啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I am reading them!"

events.source: 【瑞穗抱起一盒物品，刚想往前走，朝仓叫住她。】
events.text: 【瑞穗抱起一盒物品，刚想往前走，朝仓叫住她。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho picks up a box and is about to walk away when Asakura stops her.]

events.source: 「支手小姐，先核对编号。这一盒是另一组的。」
events.text: 「支手小姐，先核对编号。这一盒是另一组的。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Ms. Shite, check the number first. That box belongs to the other group."

events.source: 「你刚才根本没看嘛！」
events.text: 「你刚才根本没看嘛！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "You didn't read it at all!"

events.source: 「我以为盒子长得一样，里面就一样！」
events.text: 「我以为盒子长得一样，里面就一样！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I thought if the boxes looked the same, the contents would be the same!"

events.source: 「医院里很多东西看起来差不多。所以才要认真确认。」
events.text: 「医院里很多东西看起来差不多。所以才要认真确认。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Many things in a hospital look similar. That's why we check carefully."

events.source: 【瑞穗把盒子放回桌上，低头重新核对。】
events.text: 【瑞穗把盒子放回桌上，低头重新核对。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho puts the box back on the table and looks down to check again.]

events.source: 「……好。这个是三号，那边是二号……」
events.text: 「……好。这个是三号，那边是二号……」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Okay. This is number three, that one's number two..."

events.source: 「找到了。这个才是我们要送的。」
events.text: 「找到了。这个才是我们要送的。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Found it. This is the one we need to deliver."

events.source: 「……千早，你怎么这么快！」
events.text: 「……千早，你怎么这么快！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Chihaya, how are you so fast?!"

events.source: 「因为我有认真看呀！」
events.text: 「因为我有认真看呀！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Because I actually read it!"

events.source: 「可恶！第一次工作就被你领先了！」
events.text: 「可恶！第一次工作就被你领先了！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Darn it! You're already ahead of me on our first day!"

events.source: 「不需要比赛，确认正确就好。」
events.text: 「不需要比赛，确认正确就好。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "There's no need to compete. Just make sure it's correct."

events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Yes, ma'am."

events.source: 【朝仓忍不住笑了。】
events.text: 【朝仓忍不住笑了。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Asakura can't help smiling.]

events.source: 「还有，病历、药物和无菌器械不能自己随意处理。有不明白的地方，马上问带教的护士。」
events.text: 「还有，病历、药物和无菌器械不能自己随意处理。有不明白的地方，马上问带教的护士。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Also, don't handle medical records, medication, or sterile instruments however you please. If you don't understand something, ask the nurse supervising you immediately."

events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Okay!"

events.source: 「明白！」
events.text: 「明白！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Understood!"

events.source: 「今天你们先把这些轻便物品整理好。其他事情等熟悉工作区域再安排。」
events.text: 「今天你们先把这些轻便物品整理好。其他事情等熟悉工作区域再安排。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "For today, start by organizing these light supplies. We'll arrange other tasks once you know your way around the work areas."

events.source: 「终于轮到我们给别人准备东西啦。」
events.text: 「终于轮到我们给别人准备东西啦。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "It's finally our turn to prepare things for other people."

events.source: 「以前都是我们躺在病床上等别人给我们准备。」
events.text: 「以前都是我们躺在病床上等别人给我们准备。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Before, we were always lying in bed waiting for someone to prepare things for us."

events.source: 「所以这次也请你们认真照顾下一位患者。」
events.text: 「所以这次也请你们认真照顾下一位患者。」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Then this time, please take good care of the next patient too."

events.source: 【两人一齐点头。】
events.text: 【两人一齐点头。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [They both nod.]

events.source: 「我们会的。」
events.text: 「我们会的。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "We will."

events.source: 「包在我们身上！」
events.text: 「包在我们身上！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Leave it to us!"

events.source: 【朝仓回护士站安排其他工作。千早与瑞穗核对好物品，慢慢走向工作区。】
events.text: 【朝仓回护士站安排其他工作。千早与瑞穗核对好物品，慢慢走向工作区。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Asakura returns to the nurses' station to arrange other work. Chihaya and Mizuho check the supplies and walk slowly toward the work area.]

events.source: 【走廊另一端，御園芹香穿着影像科工作白大褂，刚处理完一项会诊，正要经过。】
events.text: 【走廊另一端，御園芹香穿着影像科工作白大褂，刚处理完一项会诊，正要经过。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [At the other end of the corridor, Serika Misono, in her radiology white coat, has just finished a consultation and is about to pass by.]

events.source: 「……啊！御園医生！」
events.text: 「……啊！御園医生！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Oh! Dr. Misono!"

events.source: 【芹香回过头，看到两人穿着白色护士服，稍稍停住脚步。】
events.text: 【芹香回过头，看到两人穿着白色护士服，稍稍停住脚步。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Serika turns and pauses at the sight of them in white nurse uniforms.]

events.source: 「……仓本小姐？支手小姐？」
events.text: 「……仓本小姐？支手小姐？」
events.speaker: 芹香
events.en: "...Ms. Kuramoto? Ms. Shite?"

events.source: 「好久不见！这次我们可不是以患者身份回来的哦！」
events.text: 「好久不见！这次我们可不是以患者身份回来的哦！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Long time no see! We're not back as patients this time!"

events.source: 「对呀！我们今天正式来星见打工啦！当三个月临时护士助手！」
events.text: 「对呀！我们今天正式来星见打工啦！当三个月临时护士助手！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Right! We're officially starting work at Hoshimi today! Three months as temporary nursing assistants!"

events.source: 【芹香看了一眼两人的护士服。】
events.text: 【芹香看了一眼两人的护士服。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Serika glances at their uniforms.]

events.source: 「……肯定是城宮院长的主意吧？」
events.text: 「……肯定是城宮院长的主意吧？」
events.speaker: 芹香
events.en: "...Director Shiromiya's idea, I assume?"

events.source: 「是呀是呀！」
events.text: 「是呀是呀！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Yes, exactly!"

events.source: 【芹香轻轻叹了口气。】
events.text: 【芹香轻轻叹了口气。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Serika sighs softly.]

events.source: 「……她真的干得出来。」
events.text: 「……她真的干得出来。」
events.speaker: 芹香
events.en: "...She really would do that."

events.source: 【千早和瑞穗同时笑了起来。】
events.text: 【千早和瑞穗同时笑了起来。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Chihaya and Mizuho laugh together.]

events.source: 「御園医生，我们会认真工作的！」
events.text: 「御園医生，我们会认真工作的！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Dr. Misono, we'll work hard!"

events.speaker: 芹香
events.en: "...Good."

events.source: 「以后又能在医院见面啦！」
events.text: 「以后又能在医院见面啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "We'll get to see you at the hospital again!"

events.source: 「有问题先问带你的护士。别逞强。」
events.text: 「有问题先问带你的护士。别逞强。」
events.speaker: 芹香
events.en: "Ask the nurse guiding you if you have questions. Don't overdo it."

events.source: 「知道啦！」
events.text: 「知道啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "We know!"

events.source: 【芹香向她们点点头，继续往影像科方向走去。临近上午九点，两人抱着物品走向护士站旁的工作区。】
events.text: 【芹香向她们点点头，继续往影像科方向走去。临近上午九点，两人抱着物品走向护士站旁的工作区。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Serika nods and continues toward radiology. As nine o'clock approaches, the two carry their supplies toward the work area beside the nurses' station.]

events.source: 【场景回到事件当天上午九点的病区走廊。瑞穗与千早穿着白色护士制服，站在坂口面前。】
events.text: 【场景回到事件当天上午九点的病区走廊。瑞穗与千早穿着白色护士制服，站在坂口面前。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [The scene returns to the ward corridor at nine on the morning of the event. Mizuho and Chihaya stand before Sakaguchi in their white nurse uniforms.]

events.source: 【瑞穗已经把刚才那段经过讲完。坂口沉默了片刻。】
events.text: 【瑞穗已经把刚才那段经过讲完。坂口沉默了片刻。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho has finished explaining what happened. Sakaguchi is silent for a moment.]

events.source: 「……所以，你们两个都签了三个月的临时工作合同。」
events.text: 「……所以，你们两个都签了三个月的临时工作合同。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "...So you both signed three-month temporary employment contracts."

events.source: 「对呀！」
events.text: 「对呀！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "That's right!"

events.source: 「仓本小姐也是自己决定参加的？」
events.text: 「仓本小姐也是自己决定参加的？」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "And you chose to join of your own accord too, Ms. Kuramoto?"

events.source: 「……嗯。是我主动的。」
events.text: 「……嗯。是我主动的。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Yes. It was my idea."

events.source: 【坂口看了看两人的制服。】
events.text: 【坂口看了看两人的制服。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Sakaguchi looks at their uniforms.]

events.source: 「……我现在理解为什么你们会穿成这样了。」
events.text: 「……我现在理解为什么你们会穿成这样了。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "...Now I understand why you're dressed like this."

events.source: 「哈哈哈！你刚才的表情真的太好笑了！」
events.text: 「哈哈哈！你刚才的表情真的太好笑了！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Hahaha! Your face just now was so funny!"

events.source: 「我只是没想到，上个月还在病房里的两个人，今天就跑来这里上班。」
events.text: 「我只是没想到，上个月还在病房里的两个人，今天就跑来这里上班。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "I simply didn't expect two people who were in the ward last month to turn up here for work today."

events.source: 「我们也没想到会变成这样呀。」
events.text: 「我们也没想到会变成这样呀。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "We didn't expect this either."

events.source: 「可是我觉得很有意思！」
events.text: 「可是我觉得很有意思！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "But I think it's interesting!"

events.source: 「恢复情况都确认过了吧？现在能正常做这些辅助工作？」
events.text: 「恢复情况都确认过了吧？现在能正常做这些辅助工作？」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "Your recovery has been checked, hasn't it? You're able to do this support work normally now?"

events.source: 「嗯。我们都按要求复查过。今天先做轻便的工作。」
events.text: 「嗯。我们都按要求复查过。今天先做轻便的工作。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Yes. We've both had our follow-ups as instructed. We're starting with light work today."

events.source: 「朝仓护士还特意叮嘱我，别抢着搬重东西！」
events.text: 「朝仓护士还特意叮嘱我，别抢着搬重东西！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Nurse Asakura specifically reminded me not to rush to carry heavy things!"

events.source: 「那你听了吗？」
events.text: 「那你听了吗？」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "And did you listen?"

events.source: 「……当然听了！」
events.text: 「……当然听了！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "...Of course I did!"

events.source: 「她刚才还拿错物品盒。」
events.text: 「她刚才还拿错物品盒。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "She picked up the wrong supply box earlier."

events.source: 「千早！！那个已经过去了！！」
events.text: 「千早！！那个已经过去了！！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Chihaya!! That's over and done with!!"

events.source: 【坂口笑了一下。】
events.text: 【坂口笑了一下。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Sakaguchi smiles.]

events.source: 「我倒觉得你们很快就会熟悉这里。」
events.text: 「我倒觉得你们很快就会熟悉这里。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "I think you'll both get used to things here quickly."

events.source: 「真的吗？」
events.text: 「真的吗？」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Really?"

events.source: 「不过先记住，病房准备和巡回辅助都有具体职责。别以为穿了护士服，就可以随便碰手术器械。」
events.text: 「不过先记住，病房准备和巡回辅助都有具体职责。别以为穿了护士服，就可以随便碰手术器械。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "But remember first: ward preparation and circulating support each have specific duties. Wearing a nurse uniform doesn't mean you can touch surgical instruments whenever you like."

events.source: 「院长跟我们说过啦！我现在连器械盒子都得先核对标签！」
events.text: 「院长跟我们说过啦！我现在连器械盒子都得先核对标签！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "The director told us! Now I even have to check labels on instrument boxes first!"

events.source: 「看来朝仓护士已经开始带你们了。」
events.text: 「看来朝仓护士已经开始带你们了。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "It sounds like Nurse Asakura has already started showing you the ropes."

events.source: 「嗯。她很认真。」
events.text: 「嗯。她很认真。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Yes. She's very thorough."

events.source: 「还有！我们刚才碰到御園医生了！」
events.text: 「还有！我们刚才碰到御園医生了！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Oh, and we ran into Dr. Misono earlier!"

events.source: 「御園医生？」
events.text: 「御園医生？」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "Dr. Misono?"

events.source: 「她一听说我们回来当护士，立刻就猜到是城宮院长的主意！」
events.text: 「她一听说我们回来当护士，立刻就猜到是城宮院长的主意！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "The moment she heard we'd come back as nurses, she guessed it was Director Shiromiya's idea!"

events.source: 「然后叹了好大一口气！」
events.text: 「然后叹了好大一口气！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Then she let out such a big sigh!"

events.source: 【坂口忍不住笑出了声。】
events.text: 【坂口忍不住笑出了声。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Sakaguchi bursts out laughing.]

events.source: 「……她还真了解明日香院长。」
events.text: 「……她还真了解明日香院长。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "...She really does know Director Asuka."

events.source: 「对吧！御園医生总能一下子说到重点。」
events.text: 「对吧！御園医生总能一下子说到重点。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Right? Dr. Misono always gets straight to the point."

events.source: 「说起来，你们两个现在重新走进手术室，感觉会不会和以前不一样？」
events.text: 「说起来，你们两个现在重新走进手术室，感觉会不会和以前不一样？」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "Speaking of which, do you think going back into the operating room will feel different now?"

events.source: 【千早想了想，伸手扶了扶自己的护士帽。】
events.text: 【千早想了想，伸手扶了扶自己的护士帽。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Chihaya thinks for a moment and adjusts her nurse cap.]

events.source: 「……应该会吧。」
events.text: 「……应该会吧。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...I think so."

events.source: 「我第三次手术的时候，明明是自己走进去的，可看到手术台还是紧张得不行。」
events.text: 「我第三次手术的时候，明明是自己走进去的，可看到手术台还是紧张得不行。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "For my third operation, I walked in myself, but seeing the operating table still made me incredibly nervous."

events.source: 「后来陪瑞穗的那次，我坐在旁边看大家工作，感觉又不一样。」
events.text: 「后来陪瑞穗的那次，我坐在旁边看大家工作，感觉又不一样。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Then when I accompanied Mizuho, I sat beside her and watched everyone work. That felt different again."

events.source: 「这次轮到我们帮忙准备别人上台啦！」
events.text: 「这次轮到我们帮忙准备别人上台啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Now it's our turn to help prepare other people for the table!"

events.source: 「先把普通工作做好。进手术室也要跟着有经验的护士。」
events.text: 「先把普通工作做好。进手术室也要跟着有经验的护士。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "Start by doing the ordinary work properly. Follow the experienced nurses when you go into the operating room too."

events.source: 「没问题！」
events.text: 「没问题！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "No problem!"

events.source: 「……不过要是有人突然对我说『仓本小姐，请上手术台』，我可能还是会抖一下。」
events.text: 「……不过要是有人突然对我说『仓本小姐，请上手术台』，我可能还是会抖一下。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...But if someone suddenly says, 'Ms. Kuramoto, please get onto the operating table,' I might still shiver."

events.source: 「哈哈！那我就站在旁边跟她说『放心啦，护士们都很专业』！」
events.text: 「哈哈！那我就站在旁边跟她说『放心啦，护士们都很专业』！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Haha! Then I'll stand beside her and say, 'Don't worry, the nurses are all professionals!'"

events.source: 「……你当时开刀之前也这么说。」
events.text: 「……你当时开刀之前也这么说。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...You said that before your operation too."

events.source: 「然后我就知道真的很可怕了！」
events.text: 「然后我就知道真的很可怕了！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "And then I learned it really was scary!"

events.source: 「看来你终于承认了。」
events.text: 「看来你终于承认了。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "It seems you've finally admitted it."

events.source: 「承认啊！可怕归可怕，我那台手术不是也好好完成了吗？」
events.text: 「承认啊！可怕归可怕，我那台手术不是也好好完成了吗？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "I admit it! Scary or not, didn't my operation turn out fine?"

events.source: 「……这倒是真的。」
events.text: 「……这倒是真的。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...That's true."

events.source: 【瑞穗冲千早眨了眨眼，随后转向坂口。】
events.text: 【瑞穗冲千早眨了眨眼，随后转向坂口。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho winks at Chihaya, then turns to Sakaguchi.]

events.source: 「对了，坂口医生。」
events.text: 「对了，坂口医生。」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "By the way, Dr. Sakaguchi."

events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "Hm?"

events.source: 「以后在医院碰见你，我们是不是也算同事了？」
events.text: 「以后在医院碰见你，我们是不是也算同事了？」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "When we run into you at the hospital now, does that make us colleagues?"

events.source: 「按合同来说，是。」
events.text: 「按合同来说，是。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "According to your contracts, yes."

events.source: 「那请多指教啦！」
events.text: 「那请多指教啦！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Then I look forward to working with you!"

events.source: 【瑞穗向坂口微微鞠躬，又抬起头笑起来。】
events.text: 【瑞穗向坂口微微鞠躬，又抬起头笑起来。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Mizuho bows slightly to Sakaguchi, then raises her head with a smile.]

events.source: 「我也是。请多指教！」
events.text: 「我也是。请多指教！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Me too. I look forward to working with you!"

events.source: 「嗯。欢迎来到星见。」
events.text: 「嗯。欢迎来到星见。」
events.speaker: 坂口
events.en: "Likewise. Welcome to Hoshimi."

events.source: 【护士站方向传来朝仓的招呼。】
events.text: 【护士站方向传来朝仓的招呼。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Asakura calls from the nurses' station.]

events.source: 「支手小姐、仓本小姐！刚才确认好的那批物品，麻烦送到这边来！」
events.text: 「支手小姐、仓本小姐！刚才确认好的那批物品，麻烦送到这边来！」
events.speaker: 朝仓
events.en: "Ms. Shite, Ms. Kuramoto! Please bring that batch of supplies we checked over here!"

events.source: 「好——！马上来！」
events.text: 「好——！马上来！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "Okay! Coming!"

events.source: 「知道了！」
events.text: 「知道了！」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "Got it!"

events.source: 【两人刚要跑起来，千早先停住脚步，回头看了瑞穗一眼。】
events.text: 【两人刚要跑起来，千早先停住脚步，回头看了瑞穗一眼。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [They are about to run when Chihaya stops first and looks back at Mizuho.]

events.source: 「……走慢一点，别又逞强。」
events.text: 「……走慢一点，别又逞强。」
events.speaker: 千早
events.en: "...Slow down. Don't overdo it again."

events.source: 「你也是！」
events.text: 「你也是！」
events.speaker: 瑞穗
events.en: "You too!"

events.source: 【两人改为快步向护士站走去，一边重新核对手上的物品标签。】
events.text: 【两人改为快步向护士站走去，一边重新核对手上的物品标签。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [They switch to a brisk walk toward the nurses' station, checking the labels on their supplies again as they go.]

events.source: 【坂口站在走廊里，看着她们加入忙碌的护士站。】
events.text: 【坂口站在走廊里，看着她们加入忙碌的护士站。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Sakaguchi stands in the corridor, watching them join the busy nurses' station.]

events.source: 「……从患者变成同事。」
events.text: 「……从患者变成同事。」
events.speaker: 坂口（心声）
events.en: "...From patients to colleagues."

events.source: 「星见医院，还真是什么事都可能发生啊。」
events.text: 「星见医院，还真是什么事都可能发生啊。」
events.speaker: 坂口（心声）
events.en: "Anything really can happen at Hoshimi Hospital."

events.source: 【坂口收起工作记录，继续当天的工作。】
events.text: 【坂口收起工作记录，继续当天的工作。】
events.speaker: 旁白
events.en: [Sakaguchi puts away his work records and continues the day's work.]

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「坂口医生，这几份是今天的病房准备记录。我按病房顺序放好了。」
work.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, these are today's ward preparation records. I've put them in ward order."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「这一栏还没确认，我做了记号。等负责的护士看过，再补上就好。」
work.en: "This field hasn't been confirmed yet, so I've marked it. We can fill it in once the responsible nurse has checked it."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「我以前在这里等的是检查结果，现在等的是前辈派工作。心情还真不一样呢。」
work.en: "I used to wait here for test results. Now I wait for work assignments from the experienced nurses. It feels quite different."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「病房用品的编号好多……还好有人教我整理。我先把确认过的送过去。」
work.en: "There are so many supply numbers... I'm glad someone's teaching me how to organize them. I'll deliver the ones we've checked first."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「坂口医生，你要找的那份交接表在最上面。我猜到你会先问那张，就顺手放好了。」
work.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, the handover form you're looking for is on top. I guessed you'd ask for it first, so I put it there."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「瑞穗刚才一口气揽了三件事。我去提醒她先看清楚是哪三件。」
work.en: "Mizuho just took on three things at once. I'll remind her to check what those three things actually are."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「坂口医生！今天有什么要帮忙的？跑腿、送单子、找人，我都来！」
work.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi! What needs doing today? Errands, delivering forms, finding people—I'm ready!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「我把交接表送到了！……只是表格上的缩写还得让前辈再教我一次。」
work.en: "I've delivered the handover form! ...Though I'll need someone to teach me the abbreviations again."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「千早说，在护士站工作不能只靠气势。哎呀，我知道啦，我有认真看记录的！」
work.en: "Chihaya says enthusiasm alone won't get you through work at the nurses' station. I know! I am reading the records properly!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「有人问我为什么来星见工作。我就实话说：起初是为了还医疗费，没想到跟大家一起做事也挺有意思！」
work.en: "Someone asked why I came to work at Hoshimi. I told the truth: at first it was to pay my medical bill, but working with everyone turned out to be pretty interesting!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「嗯？拿东西先看标签？当然啦！我以前才不会想到医院连同一种东西都有好几个规格。」
work.en: "Hm? Read the labels before taking supplies? Of course! I never used to realize hospitals had several specifications for even the same kind of item."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「今天我负责送两层楼的物品。运动量还不错嘛，至少比躺在病床上有意思！」
work.en: "I'm delivering supplies to two floors today. It's a decent workout, and at least it's more interesting than lying in a hospital bed!"

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「今天的病房准备由我帮忙。嗯，我会照着前辈确认过的清单做。」
work.en: "I'll help with ward preparation today. Yes, I'll follow the checklist the experienced nurses have confirmed."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「您好，我是仓本千早。先帮您核对基本资料，有不舒服的地方请告诉我。」
work.en: "Hello, I'm Chihaya Kuramoto. I'll start by checking your basic details. Please tell me if anything feels uncomfortable."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「更换用的用品和记录表都拿来了。我先让负责护士确认一遍。」
work.en: "I've brought the replacement supplies and record sheet. I'll have the responsible nurse check them first."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「要进手术室了，会紧张吧……我懂。您想问什么，可以慢慢说。」
work.en: "Going into the operating room can make you nervous... I understand. Take your time asking whatever you need to."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「如果有点害怕，也不用勉强自己装作没事。医生和护士都会听您说的。」
work.en: "If you're scared, you don't need to pretend you're fine. The doctors and nurses will listen."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「这一项还没做完，我标在表上了。等前辈处理好，再进行下一步。」
work.en: "This item isn't finished yet. I've marked it on the form. We'll move on once the nurse has dealt with it."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「准备记录核对好了。接送的时间我再跟负责护士确认一下。」
work.en: "The preparation record has been checked. I'll confirm the transport time with the responsible nurse again."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「患者刚才说过的担心，我也写在交接里了。麻烦接下来的护士留意一下。」
work.en: "I've included the patient's concerns in the handover too. Please ask the next nurse to keep an eye on them."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「这边的辅助准备结束了。……从床边这一侧看，真的跟以前完全不同呢。」
work.en: "My part of the preparation is finished. ...It really does feel different from this side of the bed."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「交给我吧！……我会先看清单，再动手。千早已经提醒过我了。」
work.en: "Leave it to me! ...I'll read the checklist before I start. Chihaya's already reminded me."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「您好，我是支手瑞穗！今天帮忙做准备，哪里不舒服就跟我们说哦。」
work.en: "Hello, I'm Mizuho Shite! I'm helping with preparation today. Tell us if anything feels wrong."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「用品拿齐了！型号和数量都请前辈看过，没擅自挑一个就算。」
work.en: "All the supplies are here! The nurse checked the types and quantities. I didn't just pick any old ones."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「怕手术？唔……其实我也怕过。您现在紧张，完全正常啦。」
work.en: "Scared of surgery? Well... I was scared too. It's completely normal to feel nervous right now."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「我以前还大言不惭说过『有什么好怕的』。嗯，后来才知道这话最好别随便讲。」
work.en: "I once boasted, 'What's so scary about it?' Yes, afterward I learned it's best not to say that so casually."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「还有这项没完成。我先记着，不会为了赶时间就打勾的。」
work.en: "This item still isn't done. I'll note it down. I won't tick it off just to hurry things along."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「转运床到了？等一下，交接记录我再跟前辈核一次！」
work.en: "The transport trolley's here? Wait, let me check the handover record with the nurse once more!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「患者说她最担心等会儿的准备，我已经告诉接班护士了。还有问题也会继续问的。」
work.en: "The patient said she's most worried about the preparation coming up. I've told the nurse taking over. We'll keep asking if she has more questions."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「病房这边完成啦！刚才跑来跑去那么忙，原来以前也有人替我做过这些呀。」
work.en: "Ward preparation's finished! After all that running around, I realize someone used to do all this for me too."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「巡回辅助，明白。我先核对外围交接，再听下一步安排。」
work.en: "Circulating support, understood. I'll check the peripheral handover first, then wait for the next instructions."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「外围用品和记录表准备好了。请负责护士再确认一次。」
work.en: "The peripheral supplies and record forms are ready. Please have the responsible nurse check them again."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「监护数据我在看。有变化的话，我会马上告诉大家。」
work.en: "I'm watching the monitor readings. I'll tell everyone immediately if anything changes."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「需要的物品已经找到了。我从外侧交给负责护士。」
work.en: "I've found the supplies we need. I'll pass them to the responsible nurse from outside the sterile area."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「手术的关键时间记下了。下一步请继续指示。」
work.en: "I've recorded the key operating times. Please give me the next instructions."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「患者入室时好像很紧张。我会留意她有没有什么想问的。」
work.en: "The patient seemed nervous on arrival. I'll watch for anything she wants to ask."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「那边是无菌区，我把需要的东西交给能接手的人。」
work.en: "That's the sterile area. I'll pass the supplies to someone who can receive them."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「记录已经整理好，我跟负责护士一起核对转运交接。」
work.en: "The records are organized. I'll check the transfer handover together with the responsible nurse."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「手术结束了……呼。记录我会再仔细核对一遍，然后去交接。」
work.en: "The operation's over... Phew. I'll check the records carefully once more, then hand over."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「我来负责巡回辅助！要找东西还是要联络人，尽管叫我！」
work.en: "I'll handle circulating support! If you need something fetched or someone contacted, just call me!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「外围用品和记录表都送齐了！我跟负责护士核对过，随时听安排！」
work.en: "The peripheral supplies and forms are all here! I've checked them with the responsible nurse and I'm ready for instructions!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「监护我盯着呢。有不对劲的变化，我立刻报告！」
work.en: "I'm watching the monitor. If anything changes in a worrying way, I'll report it immediately!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「需要补的东西我拿来了。哎，停在这里交接，对吧？」
work.en: "I've brought the extra supplies. Oh, stop here to hand them over, right?"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「时间记上了！原来手术时要记录的事情这么多啊。」
work.en: "Time recorded! I never realized how many things need recording during surgery."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「她入室的时候好像有点紧张。我会问问她是不是想跟护士说话。」
work.en: "She seemed a little nervous when she came in. I'll ask whether she wants to talk to a nurse."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「那台子上的东西我可不碰。上次亲眼见过，知道你们有多认真！」
work.en: "I'm not touching anything on that table. I saw last time how seriously you take it!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「转运和记录我跟前辈对过了。下一班需要知道的我也会交代。」
work.en: "I've checked transport and records with the nurse. I'll tell the next shift what they need to know too."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「结束啦！呼……手术台旁边忙归忙，总比自己躺在上面强！」
work.en: "Finished! Phew... Working beside the operating table is busy, but it's better than lying on it myself!"

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「我负责的辅助部分已经完成。坂口医生，辛苦了。」
work.en: "My support duties are complete. Thank you for your work, Dr. Sakaguchi."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「记录和物品交接好了。如果还有需要核对的，我就在护士站。」
work.en: "The records and supplies have been handed over. I'll be at the nurses' station if anything else needs checking."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「……每次听见『手术结束』，都还是会松一口气。」
work.en: "...I still breathe a sigh of relief every time I hear, 'The operation is over.'"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「辛苦啦，坂口医生！我再把剩下的交接做完！」
work.en: "Good work, Dr. Sakaguchi! I'll finish the remaining handover!"

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「这台做完啦！当巡回真不是只要跑得快就行呢。」
work.en: "That's this one done! Being a circulating nurse takes more than running fast."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「记录交好了！患者转运那边也有人接应，放心吧。」
work.en: "Records handed over! Someone's ready to receive the patient for transport too, so don't worry."

work.speaker: 千早
work.text: 「器械护士要负责无菌器械。我现在只能做病房准备或者非无菌巡回哦。」
work.en: "Scrub nurses handle sterile instruments. Right now, I can only do ward preparation or nonsterile circulating work."

work.speaker: 瑞穗
work.text: 「器械位啊？这个我可不敢随便上！让我做外围辅助吧。」
work.en: "Scrub duties? I wouldn't dare jump into those! Let me help outside the sterile area."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「坂口医生，我把今天要送的资料按时间分成三组啦。」
nodes.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, I've divided today's documents for delivery into three groups by time."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「安排得很清楚。」
nodes.en: "That's very clearly organized."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「以前带长曲棍球队时，我也喜欢把练习项目一条条写下来。瑞穗老说我一安排事情就停不住。」
nodes.en: "When I captained the lacrosse team, I liked writing out every practice activity too. Mizuho always says I can't stop once I start organizing."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「确实很像你。」
nodes.en: "That does sound like you."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「才、才没那么夸张！不过事先排好顺序，大家就不会手忙脚乱了嘛。」
nodes.en: "I-it's not that bad! But if we decide the order first, nobody has to scramble."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「坂口医生，这杯茶给你。刚才泡茶的时候，顺手多泡了一杯。」
nodes.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, this tea's for you. I happened to make an extra cup just now."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「谢谢。特地帮我拿过来？」
nodes.en: "Thank you. Did you bring it especially for me?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「不、不是特地啦！真的只是顺手！」
nodes.en: "N-no, not especially! I just happened to!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「我还没说什么呢。」
nodes.en: "I haven't said anything yet."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「……那就快点喝嘛。放凉了就不好喝了。」
nodes.en: "...Then drink it already. It won't taste as good cold."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「今天的交班资料整理得不错。」
nodes.en: "You organized today's handover papers well."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「哎？真的？……你说得这么平常，我差点没反应过来。」
nodes.en: "Huh? Really? ...You said it so casually I almost missed it."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「做得好就应该夸奖。」
nodes.en: "Good work deserves praise."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「……那我就收下啦。你刚才那句，我可是会记住的。」
nodes.en: "...Then I'll accept it. I'll remember what you just said."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「坂口医生，留美前辈教了我一个诀窍！先看好要送到哪几个地方，再决定怎么走。」
nodes.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, Rumi taught me a trick! Check all the delivery destinations first, then decide your route."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「很实用。」
nodes.en: "Very useful."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「对吧？我试过一次，真的少绕了好多路！」
nodes.en: "Right? I tried it once and really cut out a lot of detours!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「千早怎么说？」
nodes.en: "What did Chihaya say?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「她说我终于肯先动脑子再动腿了。……真是的，我跑得快也有功劳嘛！」
nodes.en: "That I'd finally agreed to use my head before my legs. ...Honestly, running fast deserves some credit too!"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「坂口医生，哪天下班早，要不要一起去喝点东西？」
nodes.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, want to get something to drink together one day when we finish early?"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「今天恐怕还有工作。」
nodes.en: "I'm afraid I still have work today."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「我又没说今天！医生怎么一听我邀请就这么紧张？」
nodes.en: "I didn't say today! Why do you get so nervous the moment I invite you?"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「……我没有紧张。」
nodes.en: "...I'm not nervous."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「嘿嘿，那我就记下啦。下次再问你！」
nodes.en: "Hehe, then I'll remember that. I'll ask again next time!"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「千早又把两份清单分得整整齐齐。她怎么总能比我先找到重点啊？」
nodes.en: "Chihaya's sorted two checklists so neatly again. How does she always spot what's important before me?"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「她做事比较仔细。」
nodes.en: "She's quite careful in her work."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「哼，跑腿速度我可不会输。……不过记录整理这件事，我还得多跟她学两招！」
nodes.en: "Hmph, she won't beat me at running errands. ...But I still need to learn a few tricks from her about organizing records!"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「今天有位患者问我，进手术室会不会很可怕。」
nodes.en: "A patient asked me today whether going into the operating room would be scary."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你怎么说？」
nodes.en: "What did you say?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「我说『会紧张很正常』。差点还想说『我以前也逃跑过』……幸好忍住了。」
nodes.en: "I said it was normal to feel nervous. I nearly added, 'I used to run away too'... Luckily I stopped myself."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「要不要说，得看对方想听什么。」
nodes.en: "Whether to tell her depends on what she wants to hear."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「嗯。我现在才知道，听别人把话说完有多重要。」
nodes.en: "Yes. I'm only now realizing how important it is to let people finish speaking."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「今天有位患者一直把毯角折起来，又展开。我问她怎么了，她才说是在等检查结果。」
nodes.en: "A patient kept folding and unfolding the corner of her blanket today. When I asked what was wrong, she said she was waiting for test results."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你发现得很仔细。」
nodes.en: "That was very observant."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「她其实攒了一大堆想问医生的问题。我帮她记在纸上，等你过去就能直接问了。」
nodes.en: "She actually had lots of questions for the doctor. I helped write them down so she can ask you when you visit."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「很有帮助。」
nodes.en: "That's helpful."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「她刚开始不好意思开口。我多等了一会儿，她才把问题都说出来了。」
nodes.en: "She was shy about speaking at first. I waited a little longer, and then she told me all her questions."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「这位患者的准备进度怎么样？」
nodes.en: "How is this patient's preparation going?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「已经完成的都在这里。不过她想知道手术大概多久，那个我没敢自己回答。」
nodes.en: "Everything completed is recorded here. But she wanted to know roughly how long the operation would take, and I didn't dare answer that myself."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「可以请负责的医生解释。」
nodes.en: "You can ask the responsible doctor to explain."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「对。我以前最怕别人随口给一个答案，现在也不想那么做。」
nodes.en: "Yes. I used to hate getting offhand answers. I don't want to do that to someone else now."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「刚才有位患者对我说，『不就是开个刀嘛，有什么好怕的』。」
nodes.en: "A patient just told me, 'It's only an operation. What's there to be scared of?'"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「这话听起来很熟悉。」
nodes.en: "That sounds familiar."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「……你别看我啦！我知道，我以前也说过！」
nodes.en: "...Don't look at me! I know, I used to say it too!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「后来呢？」
nodes.en: "And then?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「后来她问会不会痛。我就请负责的护士认真跟她解释，没敢再拍胸脯打包票。」
nodes.en: "Then she asked whether it would hurt. I asked the responsible nurse to explain properly instead of confidently promising anything."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「米田前辈刚才提醒我，患者反复问的问题最好也记在交接里。」
nodes.en: "Yoneda reminded me to include questions patients keep asking in the handover."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「她很细心。」
nodes.en: "She's very attentive."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「嗯！她说大家忙起来时，那几行字有时比一句『没事的』更有用。」
nodes.en: "Yes! She said that when everyone gets busy, those few written lines can be more useful than saying, 'It'll be fine.'"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你记住了？」
nodes.en: "Did you remember?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「当然！我刚才真的试了一次，下一班护士一看就明白了！」
nodes.en: "Of course! I actually tried it just now, and the next nurse understood immediately!"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「我以前觉得最厉害的人，就是敢躺上手术台的人。」
nodes.en: "I used to think the most impressive people were the ones brave enough to lie on the operating table."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「现在改主意了？」
nodes.en: "Have you changed your mind?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「嗯。愿意把患者的问题听完、把每件小事都做对，也挺难的。」
nodes.en: "Yes. Listening to all a patient's questions and getting every little thing right is pretty hard too."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「这也是很重要的工作。」
nodes.en: "That's very important work as well."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「所以我还得学！哼，千早也别想一直领先我！」
nodes.en: "So I still have learning to do! Hmph, Chihaya won't stay ahead of me forever!"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「刚才我正忙着核对资料，朝仓前辈硬把我叫来休息。」
nodes.en: "I was busy checking documents when Asakura practically dragged me here for a break."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你又忘记喝水了？」
nodes.en: "Did you forget to drink water again?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「……有一点。平时老提醒瑞穗别一忙就乱了节奏，轮到自己也会犯同样的毛病。」
nodes.en: "...A little. I'm always reminding Mizuho not to lose her rhythm when she's busy, but I make the same mistake myself."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「那就先休息几分钟。」
nodes.en: "Then rest for a few minutes first."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「嗯。你也别一直忙到忘记休息啊，坂口医生。」
nodes.en: "Okay. Don't get so busy you forget to rest either, Dr. Sakaguchi."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「今天我问了前辈三次同一个问题。第三次开口时，真想找地方钻进去。」
nodes.en: "I asked the nurse the same question three times today. The third time, I wanted the ground to swallow me."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「问清楚总比弄错好。」
nodes.en: "Better to ask than to get it wrong."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「她也是这么说的。……不过明天我会先把那一页笔记看完。」
nodes.en: "That's what she said too. ...But tomorrow I'll read that page of notes first."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「很像你的做法。」
nodes.en: "That sounds like your approach."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「哼。至少这次你可以夸我认真吧？」
nodes.en: "Hmph. At least this time you can praise me for being diligent, right?"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「休息日有安排吗？」
nodes.en: "Any plans for your day off?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「要去见以前长曲棍球队的队友。她们说要让我看看最近的新阵形，顺便帮忙出出主意。」
nodes.en: "I'm seeing my old lacrosse teammates. They want to show me their new formation and ask for my ideas."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「当队长的习惯还没改？」
nodes.en: "Still haven't lost the captain's habits?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「当然啦！就算不在球场上，我也还是很在意她们练得怎么样。」
nodes.en: "Of course not! Even when I'm not on the field, I still care about how their practice is going."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「听起来很有精神。」
nodes.en: "You sound full of energy."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「……你这样一说，我反而有点不好意思了。」
nodes.en: "...Now you've said that, I'm a little embarrassed."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「刚才差点想给大家订一堆超豪华的下午茶。」
nodes.en: "I nearly ordered a huge luxury afternoon tea spread for everyone just now."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「后来呢？」
nodes.en: "And then?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「想起明日香院长说的话啦。我先问了大家想不想一起喝普通的茶，结果聊得一样开心。」
nodes.en: "I remembered what Director Asuka said. I asked if everyone wanted ordinary tea together first, and we had just as much fun talking."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「看来学到东西了。」
nodes.en: "It seems you've learned something."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「我又不是学不会嘛。只是以前没怎么想过。」
nodes.en: "It's not like I can't learn. I just hadn't really thought about it before."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「我本来以为，这里的工作主要考验体力。好歹我运动还不错嘛！」
nodes.en: "I thought work here would mostly test my stamina. I'm pretty good at sports, after all!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「现在呢？」
nodes.en: "And now?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「最难的是把一堆小事记清楚，然后一样不漏地做完！」
nodes.en: "The hardest part is remembering all the little things and getting every one of them done!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「体力也还是有用的。」
nodes.en: "Stamina is still useful too."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「那当然！我打算两样都练出来！」
nodes.en: "Of course! I'm planning to train both!"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「千早今天还提醒我，别把别人的任务也一口气答应下来。」
nodes.en: "Chihaya reminded me again today not to take on everyone else's tasks at once."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你答应太多了？」
nodes.en: "Did you agree to too much?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「一点点啦。以前都是别人帮我安排日程，现在轮到我要跟大家配合了。」
nodes.en: "A little. Other people used to organize my schedule. Now I have to coordinate with everyone."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「习惯就好。」
nodes.en: "You'll get used to it."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「嗯。而且，和这些护士姐姐们一起工作真的挺有意思！」
nodes.en: "Yeah. And working with all these nurses really is fun!"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「以前住院时，我很喜欢往窗外看。至少那时候不用一直盯着天花板。」
nodes.en: "When I was hospitalized, I loved looking out the window. At least then I wasn't staring at the ceiling."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「现在能自己上天台了。」
nodes.en: "Now you can come up to the roof yourself."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「是啊。明明还是同一家医院，居然有这么多以前没见过的地方。」
nodes.en: "Yes. It's the same hospital, yet there are so many places I'd never seen."

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「我刚才陪一位患者走到检查室门口，她说自己已经紧张到腿发软了。」
nodes.en: "I walked a patient to the examination room earlier. She said she was so nervous her legs felt weak."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你怎么做？」
nodes.en: "What did you do?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「就陪她走慢一点。原来有时候不用说什么大道理，也能帮上忙。」
nodes.en: "Just walked more slowly with her. Sometimes you can help without saying anything profound."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「以后还是打算跟瑞穗去纽约？」
nodes.en: "Do you still plan to go to New York with Mizuho?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「当然啊。我们原本就说好了。」
nodes.en: "Of course. That's what we agreed."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「医院的这段经历呢？」
nodes.en: "What about your time at the hospital?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「……我想，到时候一定会记很久。虽然这里发生过的事，实在太多了！」
nodes.en: "...I think I'll remember it for a long time. So much has happened here!"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「哇，今天太阳真好！好想找个休息日去游泳呀。」
nodes.en: "Wow, what lovely sunshine! I'd love to go swimming on a day off."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你很喜欢晒太阳吧。」
nodes.en: "You like sunbathing, don't you?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「当然！我还在想，下次要不要换一套泳衣，晒出不一样的线条。」
nodes.en: "Of course! I'm even thinking of changing swimsuits next time to get different tan lines."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「别只顾着晒，忘了休息。」
nodes.en: "Don't get so caught up in tanning that you forget to rest."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「医生连这种事都要叮嘱呀？嘻嘻，那下次叫上千早，你也一起来嘛！」
nodes.en: "You even give reminders about that, Doctor? Hehe, then we'll bring Chihaya next time, and you should come too!"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「我发现，我穿着护士服进手术室，就敢大声跟大家说话。」
nodes.en: "I've noticed that when I enter the operating room in a nurse uniform, I'm brave enough to speak loudly to everyone."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「跟自己躺在台上时不同？」
nodes.en: "Different from lying on the table yourself?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「差太多了！那个手术灯一照到自己身上，胆量根本不听使唤。」
nodes.en: "Completely! Once that surgical lamp shines on me, my courage just stops listening."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「你倒是很坦率。」
nodes.en: "You're very honest about it."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「嘻嘻。吃过一次亏，至少得学会承认嘛。」
nodes.en: "Hehe. After learning the hard way, I should at least admit it."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「这里的工作，比你想象中辛苦吧？」
nodes.en: "Work here is harder than you expected, isn't it?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「辛苦！我以前哪知道护士姐姐们一天要做这么多事。」
nodes.en: "It is! I never knew the nurses did so many things in a day."

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「后悔来了吗？」
nodes.en: "Do you regret coming?"

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「怎么会？我还认识了这么多人。就算以后去纽约，这段日子我也会跟千早一直聊下去的。」
nodes.en: "Of course not! I've met so many people. Even after we go to New York, Chihaya and I will keep talking about these days."

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【护士站。瑞穗抱着一叠记录，千早正在核对另一份清单。】
nodes.en: [At the nurses' station, Mizuho holds a stack of records while Chihaya checks another list.]

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「坂口医生，我们今天可厉害啦！两个人加起来，住院经验绝对比普通新人丰富！」
nodes.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, we're amazing today! Between us, we definitely have more hospital experience than ordinary newcomers!"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「住院经验才不是护理经验啦！」
nodes.en: "Being hospitalized isn't nursing experience!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「这点千早说得对。」
nodes.en: "Chihaya's right about that."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「诶——？我还以为至少能算半个特长！」
nodes.en: "Aww! I thought it could at least count as half a special skill!"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「可以算『知道患者会紧张』的特长。其他的请认真从头学。」
nodes.en: "It can count as knowing that patients get nervous. Please learn everything else properly from the beginning."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「好嘛好嘛。那这个特长我们俩都有！」
nodes.en: "Okay, okay. Then we both have that special skill!"

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【病房外。两人刚协助正式护士完成一份准备交接。】
nodes.en: [Outside a patient room, the two have just helped a qualified nurse complete a preparation handover.]

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「那位患者说她一点都不怕，好有气势喔！」
nodes.en: "That patient said she wasn't scared at all. So confident!"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「你也说过一模一样的话。」
nodes.en: "You said exactly the same thing."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「……能不能别把这个拿出来讲啦！」
nodes.en: "...Could you stop bringing that up?!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「患者现在的反应怎么样？」
nodes.en: "How is the patient reacting now?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「她有点紧张，我们已经告诉负责护士了。」
nodes.en: "She's a little nervous. We've told the responsible nurse."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「而且我这次真的没跟她说『有什么好怕的』！」
nodes.en: "And this time I really didn't tell her, 'What's so scary about it?'"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「嗯，这点值得表扬。」
nodes.en: "Yes, that deserves praise."

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【护士休息室。千早和瑞穗刚吃完午饭。】
nodes.en: [In the nurses' lounge, Chihaya and Mizuho have just finished lunch.]

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「坂口医生，你不觉得我今天的工作效率特别高吗？」
nodes.en: "Dr. Sakaguchi, don't you think I've been especially efficient today?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「你中午还把记录夹忘在另一层楼。」
nodes.en: "You left the record folder on another floor at lunchtime."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「那也是因为我跑得太快了嘛！」
nodes.en: "That's only because I was running too fast!"

nodes.speaker: 坂口
nodes.text: 「把东西带对地方也属于效率。」
nodes.en: "Taking things to the right place is part of efficiency too."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「唔！医生和千早怎么联合起来欺负我！」
nodes.en: "Ugh! Why are you and Chihaya ganging up on me?!"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「谁叫你一见坂口医生就想邀功。先把下午的清单拿好啦。」
nodes.en: "Because you always want credit the moment you see Dr. Sakaguchi. Go get the afternoon checklist first."

nodes.speaker: 瑞穗
nodes.text: 「好啦！……不过你陪我一起去拿，好不好？」
nodes.en: "Fine! ...But will you come with me to get it?"

nodes.speaker: 千早
nodes.text: 「真拿你没办法。」
nodes.en: "What am I going to do with you?"
